response.original_title: 【@Reservation~Update™】 How Do I Change My Viking Ocean Cruise Reservation to Add Passengers?
response.overview: You can add a passenger to your existing Viking Ocean Cruise by calling Viking customer service directly at +1-877-698-2211 (US/Canada) or by contacting your original travel agent. You cannot add new travelers directly through the online portal. You can add a passenger to an existing Viking Ocean Cruises reservation by calling Viking Ocean Cruise Reservation directly at 877-698-2211 or by contacting your travel agent. To add a Passenger to an existing Viking Ocean Cruises 1[877]698[2211] reservation 1[877]698[2211], you must call 1[877]698[2211] Viking Ocean Customer Service or contact your travel agent directly 1[877]698[2211], as additions cannot be made online or through the mobile app. You cannot add a Passenger to Viking Ocean Cruises 1[877]698[2211] online 1[877]698[2211], so you must contact Viking Ocean customer service or your travel agent directly by phone 1[877]698[2211].
